metadata.description: Likely represents the domain for setting cookies in the UI.

suggestions: Ensure this value is set to the appropriate domain for cookie functionality.
Update to a meaningful domain name if cookies need to be scoped to a specific domain.

metadata.default_value: An empty string may indicate that this variable is not configured.

suggestions: Set this value to a descriptive and unique name for the cookie.

metadata.description: Appears to be a password used by the UI for authentication purposes.
metadata.security_risks: Passwords should never be stored in plain text in environment variables.
metadata.recommendation: Use a secrets management service or encrypted storage for sensitive credentials.

suggestions: Move this password to a secure secrets manager or encrypted storage.
Periodically rotate the password to ensure security best practices.
Ensure that this value is not exposed in logs or error messages.

metadata.description: Appears to be a username in the form of an email address, likely used for UI authentication.

suggestions: Ensure this email is used in conjunction with secure password authentication.
Consider masking this value in logs or other public outputs.
